title: Ethiopian Berbere Grilled Chicken
localName: ቤርበሬ ዶሮ ጥብስ — Berbere Doro Tibs
community: Modern Ethiopian restaurants and home cooks
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Berbere Grilled Chicken — whole chicken joints marinated in berbere, kibbeh, garlic, lemon, and yogurt for 4 hours, then oven-grilled until the berbere crust caramelises magnificently. The modern Ethiopian grilled chicken — a berbere-marinade technique that works for any cooking format.
longDesc: Berbere grilled chicken is the modern Ethiopian home cook's answer to oven roasting — the berbere marinade produces a crust of extraordinary colour and complexity, and the yogurt tenderises the meat.
steps: Score chicken pieces deeply. Rub marinade into every surface and score.
Marinate 4 hours minimum — overnight is better.
Place on a rack over a baking tray.
Grill (broil) last 3 minutes for the crust.
chefTips: Scoring is essential — berbere marinade must reach the bone.
The yogurt in the marinade tenderises through lactic acid.
The kibbeh carries the fat-soluble berbere compounds deep into the meat.
Rack cooking allows air circulation — crispier skin.
cookingScience: See ETH066 for berbere chicken science. The yogurt's lactic acid at 4+ hours of marination partially denatures the muscle protein surface — creating a more tender texture. The berbere's carotenoids and Maillard products during roasting create the distinctive red-brown caramelised crust.
culturalNote: Berbere grilled chicken is the modern Ethiopian home cook's adaptation — taking the ancient berbere tradition and applying it to the globally familiar roast chicken format, producing a result that is unmistakably Ethiopian.
